title: Rich & Creamy
summary: Cream, butter, and cheese carry flavor — build sauce on a roux or reduced stock first.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — rich & creamy is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: fat, salt, umami. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Use aged cheese sparingly at finish
Cut with acid (lemon, white wine) or bitter greens on the plate.
